inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root joined with unit-manifest paths for write and remove. The constructor stores this root unchanged.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.config.tree
inputs.description: SourceTree snapshot whose list and read methods supply the units config file, if present. It determines whether the default config is returned or the stored config is validated.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.read.tree
inputs.description: SourceTree snapshot whose listed files and contents provide manifests under unitsDirectory. It is used to read and validate the registry.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.write.manifests
inputs.description: Manifests to store as canonical JSON files named from each manifest id. Existing files whose contents already equal stableJson output are skipped.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.remove.id
inputs.description: Unit id used to locate its manifest JSON file under unitsDirectory. Removal uses force, so a missing file is ignored.

inputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.path.id
inputs.description: Unit id appended to unitsDirectory with a .json suffix. The method returns this repository-relative path without checking whether the file exists.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.config
outputs.description: The parsed UnitsConfig from harness.units.json when the file is present and valid; when absent, the method returns defaultUnitsConfig. Invalid JSON or schema data causes fail to throw ExpectedCliError.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.read
outputs.description: RegistryRead containing validated manifests from JSON files under specification/units, validation errors, and ids of manifests whose stored text differs from stableJson output. Historical manifests are validated with contractQuality disabled, and invalid manifests are omitted.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.write
outputs.description: Repository-relative paths of manifests whose canonical JSON contents were written. Manifests whose existing file contents already equal stableJson output are omitted.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.remove
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after attempting to remove the unit JSON file under the repository root. Missing files are ignored because removal uses force: true.

outputs.name: UnitRegistryRepository.path
outputs.description: Repository-relative manifest path formed as specification/units/<id>.json. The method does not access the filesystem.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when the parsed value of harness.units.json fails unitsConfigSchema validation. Its message is the schema errors joined with newline characters.
